question: Should this branch become the canonical provider tool-schema diagnostics hardening PR, or should its useful cases be folded into a sibling diagnostics branch before merge?
rationale: The code fix is partly mechanical, but the open maintainer-labeled draft cluster covers overlapping fallback, hook-failure, and log-sanitization behavior, so automation should not choose the final contract alone.

options.title: Consolidate Diagnostics Hardening
options.body: Choose one canonical branch, add the caught-error formatter guard, and fold in the desired descriptor, source-name, hook-failure, and sanitization behavior before merge.

options.title: Repair This Branch Narrowly
options.body: Keep this PR as the landing vehicle, fix the unsafe formatError path, and explicitly leave broader sanitization or SDK schema-walk hardening to separate follow-up PRs.

options.title: Pause Behind A Sibling
options.body: Leave this draft open until a broader sibling branch lands or is rejected, then close or rebase this PR based on the remaining unique cases.

recommendation.title: Consolidate Diagnostics Hardening
recommendation.body: Choose one canonical branch, add the caught-error formatter guard, and fold in the desired descriptor, source-name, hook-failure, and sanitization behavior before merge.
